title: Coming to New EquipRite
description: Stands in for every menu item not rebuilt yet (status 'old' or 'planned' in NAV_GROUPS): says what the redesign brings to that screen and opens the same screen in Old EquipRite. Records which item it stands for in $application.variables.laterNavId so the menu highlights it.

navId.description: Menu item id (NAV_GROUPS in app-flow.js), from the URL so a reload or bookmark keeps it.
